bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
sha=05ecb8147fa946891683234976f4e94b57b25677
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/tgtumbler-gserver-deploy-20261106 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || { echo STK04_TOPIC_INSPECT_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 71; }
d="$(mktemp -d /tmp/stk04-topic-discovery.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
git archive "$sha" | tar -xf - -C "$d"
podman build --quiet -f "$d/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t localhost/gace-stk04-inspect:05ecb814 "$d" >/dev/null || exit 72
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 73
if podman run --rm --entrypoint cat localhost/gace-stk04-inspect:05ecb814 /app/sticker-topic-pin.mjs | docker exec -i -e STICKER_PIN_MODE=inspect "$names" node --input-type=module -; then
 echo STK04_STICKER_TOPIC_CANDIDATE_READBACK=PASS
else
 echo STK04_STICKER_TOPIC_CANDIDATE_READBACK=FAIL
 exit 74
fi
